task.description: Design implementation for OIDC-07 claim validation in token verification flow. Cover signature/JWKS verification handoff points from OIDC-06, issuer and audience matching per tenant realm config, exp/nbf validation with configurable symmetric clock skew, structured auth error mapping to HTTP 401, and explicit unit/integration test plan for each invalid-case acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: Design artifact created under src/design with data flow and module-level change plan
Validation matrix includes wrong issuer, wrong audience, expired token, not-yet-valid token, and bad signature
Design explicitly defines configurable clock skew behavior applied symmetrically

result.summary: Design artefact for OIDC-07 claim validation, including OIDC-06 signature/JWKS handoff points, tenant issuer/audience checks, symmetric clock-skew rules, HTTP 401 error mapping, and explicit unit/integration invalid-case test plan.
